npmUsername.description: Your npm username (used to find your packages)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to determine dates and hours for version publish grouping (default: UTC)

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent API requests during sync

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed API requests

pageSize.description: Number of items per page for search pagination (default: 250)

exclude.description: Package names to exclude from aggregated stats (still synced for data completeness)
